rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday equivalent, especially for someone who is not feeling scared.

example.english: I am unafraid even when I walk alone at night.
example.traditional: 我一個人行夜路都唔驚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 je6 lou6 dou1 m4 geng1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone does not fear a person or thing and is willing to face it.

example.english: They are unafraid of how strong the opponent is and compete anyway.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔怕個對手幾強，都照樣落場比賽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 paa3 go3 deoi3 sau2 gei2 koeng4 dou1 ziu3 joeng6 lok6 coeng4 bei2 coi3
